description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing resource data, including state for items, pagination, filters, loading and error states, along with functions to update state and fetch data from an external resources service.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query string filter and resets page to 1.

methods.name: setProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider filter and resets page to 1.

methods.name: setPageSize
methods.description: Sets the page size and resets page to 1.

methods.name: fetchList
methods.description: Fetches a list of resources from resourcesService based on current state and optional overrides.
